Definition: probably from the base of G4525; a vibration, i.e. (specially), billow:--wave.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses sálos for a vibration, that is (specially), billow. It stands in Luke 21:25: "…earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sálos is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
